clients.name: Secret
clients.doc: The key vault client performs cryptographic key operations and vault operations against the Key Vault service.

operations.name: setSecret
operations.doc: The SET operation adds a secret to the Azure Key Vault. If the named secret already exists, Azure Key Vault creates a new version of that secret. This operation requires the secrets/set permission.

operations.name: deleteSecret
operations.doc: The DELETE operation applies to any secret stored in Azure Key Vault. DELETE cannot be applied to an individual version of a secret. This operation requires the secrets/delete permission.

operations.name: UpdateSecretProperties
operations.doc: The UPDATE operation changes specified attributes of an existing stored secret. Attributes that are not specified in the request are left unchanged. The value of a secret itself cannot be changed. This operation requires the secrets/set permission.

operations.name: getSecret
operations.doc: The GET operation is applicable to any secret stored in Azure Key Vault. This operation requires the secrets/get permission.

operations.name: ListSecretProperties
operations.doc: The Get Secrets operation is applicable to the entire vault. However, only the base secret identifier and its attributes are provided in the response. Individual secret versions are not listed in the response. This operation requires the secrets/list permission.

operations.name: ListSecretPropertiesVersions
operations.doc: The full secret identifier and attributes are provided in the response. No values are returned for the secrets. This operations requires the secrets/list permission.

operations.name: ListDeletedSecretProperties
operations.doc: The Get Deleted Secrets operation returns the secrets that have been deleted for a vault enabled for soft-delete. This operation requires the secrets/list permission.

operations.name: getDeletedSecret
operations.doc: The Get Deleted Secret operation returns the specified deleted secret along with its attributes. This operation requires the secrets/get permission.

operations.name: purgeDeletedSecret
operations.doc: The purge deleted secret operation removes the secret permanently, without the possibility of recovery. This operation can only be enabled on a soft-delete enabled vault. This operation requires the secrets/purge permission.

operations.name: recoverDeletedSecret
operations.doc: Recovers the deleted secret in the specified vault. This operation can only be performed on a soft-delete enabled vault. This operation requires the secrets/recover permission.

operations.name: backupSecret
operations.doc: Requests that a backup of the specified secret be downloaded to the client. All versions of the secret will be downloaded. This operation requires the secrets/backup permission.

operations.name: restoreSecret
operations.doc: Restores a backed up secret, and all its versions, to a vault. This operation requires the secrets/restore permission.

fields.doc: Creation time in UTC.

fields.name: recoverableDays
fields.doc: softDelete data retention days. Value should be >=7 and <=90 when softDelete enabled, otherwise 0.

fields.name: recoveryLevel
fields.doc: Reflects the deletion recovery level currently in effect for secrets in the current vault. If it contains 'Purgeable', the secret can be permanently deleted by a privileged user; otherwise, only the system can purge the secret, at the end of the retention interval.
